indicator_owner: [kyle] v2 (settings dialog title directly visible, ref_00-40)

rules.1_session_range_construction: [kyle] v2 'Market Sessions' draws a RANGE BOX spanning each session's window (session high/low). Full-session box (NOT the 15-min ORB of Part Three).
rules.2_sessions_used: London, New York, Tokyo/Asia (each a toggle + colour).
rules.3_volume_candles: 'Yellow candles' = RELATIVE VOLUME candles: highlighted when volume is high relative to a rolling average; 'market maker is present, buyers/sellers strong'.
rules.4_volume_basis: DIRECTLY VISIBLE: Relative Volume — Volume Multiplier 2, Volume Length 20 (i.e. volume vs 20-bar average x2). Colour highlight, not a fixed absolute threshold.
rules.5_vwap: Multiframe VWAP (volume-weighted average price): Session / Daily / Weekly / Monthly bands.
rules.6_vwap_role: BIAS FILTER (above VWAP=bullish, below=bearish) + dynamic SUPPORT/RESISTANCE (holds->long on retest; loses->short). Sideways VWAP='weakened/no volume'. NOT stated as a standalone entry trigger/target/veto.
rules.7_breakout_box: Price HOLDS above the session-box level -> breakout -> long (for breakout traders).
rules.8_breakdown_box: Price LOSES the session-box level -> breakdown -> short; then 'retest, fake move short'.
rules.9_wick_vs_close: CANDLE CLOSE required ('candle close below, they didn't hold -> retest short'); a WICK that sweeps the level = fakeout ('they swept this high').
rules.10_entry_stop_target_invalidation: Entry = RETEST after the break/close ('wait for retrace, take long'); mid-box DOTTED line = scalp pivot inside the range; fakeout (sweep+close-back) = reverse. Stop/target NOT numerically stated.
rules.11_direction: VWAP position (above/below) + relative-volume candle pressure + session-box break direction.
rules.12_discretionary_tips: Change colours / timezone / volume inputs; add labels; 'if you understand it, works with NASDAQ, Gold, BTC'. Interpretation is discretionary.
rules.13_component_ownership: [kyle] v2 draws the session boxes, the volume candles, AND the VWAP (single indicator, dialog title visible).
rules.15_repaint_intrabar_close_alert: Uses candle-close reasoning; repaint / intrabar / alert behaviour NOT stated -> UNKNOWN.
